boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented free UNI and Cedar Falls activities, from campus collections and gardens to public programs and outdoor music.

cards.title: Browse the UNI Gallery of Art
cards.subtitle: Kamerick Art Building, 1601 W 27th St.
cards.notes: Stop in during academic-year gallery hours to view the rotating exhibitions and permanent collection without buying a ticket.
cards.short_summary: A campus art stop with admission-free programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UNI states that all programming at the UNI Gallery of Art is admission-free.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information | College of Humanities Arts and Sciences
cards.access_notes: Open during the academic year Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed during listed academic breaks.

cards.title: Explore the UNI Museum
cards.subtitle: Rod Library, 1227 W 27th St.
cards.notes: Walk through the museum’s changing displays, then use Rod Library’s posted hours to plan a visit with friends.
cards.short_summary: Campus history, science, and cultural collections in Rod Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The UNI Museum states that attendance is free and that it is open whenever Rod Library is open.
cards.access_notes: Located in Rod Library and open during Rod Library hours.

cards.title: Take a botanical self-tour
cards.subtitle: UNI Botanical Center
cards.notes: Use the public self-tour window to slow down among the plant collections; check the department page before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A plant-focused campus visit open for public self-tours.
cards.evidence_claim: UNI lists the Botanical Center as free and open to the public for self-tours on most weekdays.
cards.source_title: For K12 Students | STEM Support Services
cards.access_notes: Self-tours are generally Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; some Friday afternoons are closed for maintenance.

cards.title: Watch for an observatory public program
cards.subtitle: UNI Earth & Environmental Science Department
cards.notes: Check the department’s announced public-program dates, then bring a friend for an astronomy-centered campus evening.
cards.short_summary: Public astronomy programs scheduled during the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: UNI identifies Observatory public programs as free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: For K12 Students | STEM Support Services
cards.access_notes: Dates, times, and show information are posted by the Earth & Environmental Science Department.

cards.title: Catch a planetarium public program
cards.subtitle: UNI Earth & Environmental Science Department
cards.notes: Look up an upcoming public program and make a low-key plan around a planetarium show when one is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A free public-program option for a skyward campus outing.
cards.evidence_claim: UNI identifies Planetarium public programs as free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: For K12 Students | STEM Support Services
cards.access_notes: Check the department website for current dates, times, and show information.

cards.title: Walk the UNI Biological Preserves
cards.subtitle: UNI Campus Preserve System
cards.notes: Choose daylight for a relaxed nature walk and stay on appropriate public routes while taking in the preserve setting.
cards.short_summary: A dawn-to-dusk public nature option connected to UNI.
cards.evidence_claim: UNI states that its Biological Preserves are open from dawn to dusk and provide recreational opportunities for the general public.
cards.source_title: For K12 Students | STEM Support Services
cards.access_notes: Open from dawn to dusk; use daylight and follow posted site guidance.

cards.title: Set up a Rod Library visitor card
cards.subtitle: Rod Library, UNI campus
cards.notes: Bring a photo ID to the Library Services Desk and ask for a visitor card for in-house databases and material checkout.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost way to use library resources during a campus visit.
cards.evidence_claim: Rod Library states it is always free and open to the public, and that visitors can obtain a free visitor card with photo ID.
cards.access_notes: Request the free visitor card at the Library Services Desk; a photo ID is required.

cards.entity_name: Cedar Falls Public Library Music Garden
cards.title: Make a few sounds in the Music Garden
cards.subtitle: Behind Cedar Falls Public Library along State Street
cards.notes: Meet behind the library and try the outdoor instruments together; keep the shared space and instruments treated with care.
cards.short_summary: Six outdoor instruments create a hands-on public music stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cedar Falls Public Library says its Music Garden is open to the public and contains six outdoor instruments.
cards.source_title: Our Music Garden | Cedar Falls Public Library
cards.access_notes: Located behind the library along State Street; follow the posted rules to respect instruments and space.

cards.entity_name: Gallagher Bluedorn Block Party at Highland Square Park
cards.title: Hear the Block Party at Highland Square
cards.subtitle: Highland Square Park, Waterloo — Aug. 14, 2026, 7–9 p.m.
cards.notes: Bring a lawn chair or blanket and join the scheduled outdoor music, food, and activity gathering without an admission charge.
cards.short_summary: A free Gallagher Bluedorn summer music stop in Waterloo.
cards.evidence_claim: UNI’s 2026 Block Party announcement lists the Highland Square Park event and says all Block Party events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Dates announced for free Gallagher Bluedorn Block Party series | inside UNI
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for Aug. 14, 2026, 7–9 p.m.; the announcement encourages attendees to bring lawn chairs or blankets.

cards.entity_name: Gallagher Bluedorn Block Party at Black Hawk Park
cards.title: Plan for the Black Hawk Park Block Party
cards.subtitle: Black Hawk Park, Cedar Falls — Sept. 5, 2026, 7–9 p.m.
cards.notes: Save the scheduled Saturday evening, bring a blanket or lawn chair, and enjoy the public music-and-activities program together.
cards.short_summary: A September free outdoor music gathering in Cedar Falls.
cards.evidence_claim: UNI’s 2026 Block Party announcement lists the Black Hawk Park event and says all Block Party events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Dates announced for free Gallagher Bluedorn Block Party series | inside UNI
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for Sept. 5, 2026, 7–9 p.m.; the announcement encourages attendees to bring lawn chairs or blankets.
